photos.title: Quilt Packaging 接點及回焊焊料顯微影像
photos.titleEn: Microscopy of Quilt Packaging nodules and reflowed solder
photos.author: Jacksontlu

a103.note: 銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a103.noteEn: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a104.note: 壓力、溫度與接合時間共同影響接點。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a104.noteEn: Pressure, temperature and time jointly affect a joint. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a105.note: 銅對銅接合不依賴回焊焊料。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連的比較照片，不是直接 Cu-Cu 或介電／銅混合接合界面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a105.noteEn: Copper-to-copper bonding is distinct from solder reflow. This Quilt Packaging solder interconnect is a comparison image, not a direct Cu-Cu or dielectric/Cu hybrid-bond interface. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a118.note: 種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連，不是 RDL 金屬線的截面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a118.noteEn: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. This shows Quilt Packaging solder interconnects, not an RDL metal-line cross-section. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a122.note: TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。圖中為外露焊料互連，不顯示 TSV 孔內部或其填充完整性。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a122.noteEn: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. Exposed solder interconnects do not show TSV interiors or fill integrity. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a148.note: 焊點壽命模型必須對應正確應變指標。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a148.noteEn: Solder-life models require the appropriate strain metric. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a150.note: X 光投影重疊不能當作三維斷層。此為 Quilt Packaging 的顯微照片，不是 X 光 CT 切片或斷層重建。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a150.noteEn: Overlapping X-ray projections are not 3D tomography. This Quilt Packaging microscopy image is not an X-ray CT slice or tomographic reconstruction. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a119.noteEn: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a126.note: 有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a126.noteEn: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a127.note: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。此 BGA 截面僅示意接點與基板位置，不能確認其核心材料是玻璃。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a127.noteEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. This BGA section locates joints and substrate but does not establish a glass-core material. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a128.note: ABF 增層依賴介電層及微孔的連續品質。此 BGA 截面不能辨識樹脂化學成分，也不能確認使用 ABF 材料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a128.noteEn: ABF build-up depends on dielectric and microvia quality. This BGA section does not identify resin chemistry or establish the use of ABF. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a133.note: 封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a133.noteEn: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a134.note: 訊號完整性包含串音與返回電流。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a134.noteEn: Signal integrity includes crosstalk and return current. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a136.note: 寄生參數與激發頻率及參考平面有關。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a136.noteEn: Parasitics depend on frequency and reference planes. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a137.note: 去耦電容的 ESL 與放置路徑影響有效性。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a137.noteEn: ESL and placement paths limit decoupling effectiveness. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a146.note: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a146.noteEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a147.note: 吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a147.noteEn: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a149.note: 聲學回波受界面與閘門深度影響。此為實體 BGA 截面的光學照片，不是超音波 A-scan 或 C-scan 檢測資料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a149.noteEn: Acoustic echoes depend on interfaces and gate depth. This optical photograph of a physical BGA section is not ultrasonic A-scan or C-scan data. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a006.note: 以矽晶圓外觀認識基板尺度；這張表面照片無法判定是否為 SOI，也看不到埋入氧化層。SOI 層次請看本課原創截面圖。
a006.noteEn: Use the wafer to orient substrate scale. This surface photograph cannot identify SOI or reveal a buried oxide; use the course cross-section for the layer structure.

a016.note: 晶圓是雷射退火的處理對象；本照片沒有雷射設備、溫度分布或摻雜活化資料，不能由顏色判定退火結果。
a016.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for laser annealing. No laser tool, temperature field or dopant-activation data is pictured; colour cannot establish an annealing result.

a024.note: 以完整晶圓對照課內 CFET 奈米截面的尺度差距；照片不是 imec 的 CFET 樣品，也不能辨認上下互補電晶體。
a024.noteEn: Compare wafer scale with the course CFET nanoscale cross-section. This is not an imec CFET sample and does not reveal stacked complementary transistors.

a027.note: 晶圓表面提供製造尺度的起點；照片沒有可驗證的技術節點資訊，不可標成次二奈米製程實拍。
a027.noteEn: The wafer surface introduces manufacturing scale. No verifiable node information is available for this image; it is not a photograph of a sub-2-nm process.

a038.note: 由晶圓上重複晶粒辨認圖案複製的尺度；OPC 修正形狀遠小於照片解析度，本圖不能驗證 OPC 成敗。
a038.noteEn: Repeated die patterns introduce the scale of pattern replication. OPC corrections are far below this photograph’s resolution; this image cannot validate OPC.

a039.note: 晶圓是成像圖案最終轉移的載體；照片沒有光罩、反向微影目標函數或模擬空中影像。請搭配本課計算流程圖。
a039.noteEn: The wafer is the substrate onto which imaging patterns are transferred. No mask, inverse-lithography objective function or simulated aerial image is pictured; use the course computation diagram.

a047.note: 晶圓照片提供電子束寫入載體的尺度背景；沒有顯示電子束柱、曝光光阻或寫入解析度。
a047.noteEn: The wafer photograph provides substrate-scale context for electron-beam writing. It does not show an electron column, exposed resist or writing resolution.

a067.note: 晶圓表面外觀作為平坦化與後續圖案製作的背景；這不是 CMP 加工中照片，光亮外觀也不能代替平坦度量測。
a067.noteEn: The wafer surface provides context for planarization and subsequent patterning. CMP is not in progress, and a reflective appearance cannot replace flatness measurement.

a068.note: 以晶圓作為漿料與磨粒作用的基板背景；照片看不到磨粒粒徑、分散性、化學組成或 CMP 去除率。
a068.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for slurry and abrasive action. The image reveals no abrasive size, dispersion, chemistry or CMP removal rate.

a106.note: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a106.noteEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a109.note: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a109.noteEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a110.note: 背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a110.noteEn: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a111.note: 隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a111.noteEn: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a117.note: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a117.noteEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a123.note: 背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a123.noteEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

guides.title: 先進封裝共同設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Advanced Packaging Co-Design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.conceptEn: Plasma dicing couples sidewalls, mask and endpoint. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。作者記錄的失敗試片；用來判讀形貌，不能直接當成量產缺陷標準。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：電漿切割需要側壁、遮罩與終點協同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以側壁殘留、崩角及切穿均勻性比較方法。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. A failed specimen documented by its author; useful for morphology interpretation, not a production defect standard.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Plasma dicing couples sidewalls, mask and endpoint. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare sidewall residue, chipping and through-cut uniformity. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以側壁殘留、崩角及切穿均勻性比較方法」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare sidewall residue, chipping and through-cut uniformity, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光柵耦合器設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Grating-coupler design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光柵耦合的角度、偏振與波長交互影響。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較波長角度二維效率圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Grating coupling couples angle, polarization and wavelength. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較波長角度二維效率圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare two-dimensional wavelength-angle efficiency maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 偏振分光與偏振旋轉是兩種功能。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Polarization splitting and rotation are distinct functions. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：偏振分光與偏振旋轉是兩種功能。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立 TE/TM 輸入與兩個輸出的功率矩陣。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Polarization splitting and rotation are distinct functions. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build a power matrix for TE/TM inputs and both outputs. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立 TE/TM 輸入與兩個輸出的功率矩陣」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build a power matrix for TE/TM inputs and both outputs, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

guides.title: 光子晶片晶圓級光測試：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level optical testing of photonic chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 晶圓光測試要分離耦合器與元件損耗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Wafer optical tests must separate coupler and device loss. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：晶圓光測試要分離耦合器與元件損耗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用參考結構、重複探測及晶圓位置圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Wafer optical tests must separate coupler and device loss. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use reference structures, repeated probing and wafer-position maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用參考結構、重複探測及晶圓位置圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use reference structures, repeated probing and wafer-position maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: CoWoS architecture differs from other lateral-interconnect examples. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：CoWoS 案例的結構與其他橫向互連不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對官方 CoWoS 變體與對應的中介層形式。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: CoWoS architecture differs from other lateral-interconnect examples. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check official CoWoS variants against their interposer approaches. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對官方 CoWoS 變體與對應的中介層形式」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check official CoWoS variants against their interposer approaches, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: EMIB 的局部橋接與整片中介層需分清。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish EMIB local bridging from a full interposer. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：EMIB 的局部橋接與整片中介層需分清。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較橋的位置、互連距離與基板區域。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish EMIB local bridging from a full interposer. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare bridge location, interconnect distance and substrate regions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較橋的位置、互連距離與基板區域」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare bridge location, interconnect distance and substrate regions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
